Status of Implementation Progress: Actively completed. Completed. Total 25 end user awareness sessions have been conducted by EESL covering 1,371 participants. (Sex disaggregated data is under compilation). EESL has collaborated with several stakeholders including NGOs, Schools, Women led organizations, State Designated Agencies, Self Help Groups etc to expand the outreach of awareness on energy efficiency across the country. Further, information dissemination is also being undertaken through EESL's social media handles - Facebook, twitter and LinkedIn.EESL has issued bid for procurement of 0.8 million smart meters in Jan 2025 to meet the requirements of Bihar DISCOM. Award is expected in May 2025 (Q2 2025). M/S AEW LOA has been short closed at 0.109 nos. of Smart meters. M/S Schneider LOA, supply has been completed for 1.71 million smart meters. 64 MW have been commissioned. 534 electric vehicles (EVs) and charging stations commissioned in eligible states.
